messages.author: 0600694caf57b8fb
messages.subject: plotting psychometric functions
parts:
Hello,

I work in psychophysics. A typical problem in this area is to adjust
psychometric functions like cumulative gaussian distributions.

I recently wrote some code to calculate and plot psychometric
functions using ggplot2. Here is the code in case someone could be
interested:

http://www.dlinares.org/Site/psychometric.html


dani

--
Daniel Linares
web: www.dlinares.org
